metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Awareness (v1.3)
metadata.subtitle: Cognitive Envelope for RTT • Regime • Measures • Paradox • Consent • Substrate • Collapse
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative awareness projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Awareness is a projection only; authoritative values come from session.state, alignments, context, log, dashboard, overlay, history, analytics, navigation, permissions, profile, trace, and render.

rtt_node.awareness: System recognizes current RTT node and its constraints.
rtt_node.notes: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.

regime.awareness: System identifies regime and its operational boundaries.
regime.notes: Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.

substrate.awareness: System is aware of substrate class and harmonic eligibility.

operator.awareness: System recognizes active operator and its measure requirements.
operator.notes: Operator MUST match current RTT node.

consent.awareness: System is aware of consent state and AA3 gating.

lineage.awareness: System tracks lineage continuity and collapse effects.

collapse.awareness: System is aware of collapse readiness and RTT12 rules.

paradox_density.awareness: System recognizes paradox density as nominal.

lattice_stability.awareness: System recognizes lattice stability as fully stable.

awareness_rules: Awareness MUST NOT invent measure IDs.
Awareness MUST NOT invent paradox types.
Awareness MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
